items.stem: Which role assignment follows least-privilege for a team member who only needs to use shared projects?

options.text: A standard member role without workspace-admin rights
options.rationale: Correct: least-privilege grants only the access the task requires.
Granting admin to all violates least-privilege and increases risk.
Billing ownership is unrelated to using shared projects and over-grants access.
Removing access prevents the member from doing their job.

items.explanation: Correct: least-privilege grants only the access the task requires.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which is the better measure of successful ChatGPT adoption on a team?

options.text: Hours saved on a defined recurring task after rollout
options.rationale: Correct: a value-based outcome measures real benefit, not mere activity.

options.text: Total number of messages sent per day
options.rationale: Message volume is activity, not value, and is easy to inflate.

options.text: How many people logged in once
options.rationale: A single login does not indicate sustained, valuable use.
Model version is not an adoption outcome.

items.explanation: Correct: a value-based outcome measures real benefit, not mere activity.

items.stem: Which TWO workspace settings should an admin confirm for a team handling confidential data? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: retention settings govern how long and whether data is kept.

options.text: Whether workspace data is excluded from model training per the tier's controls
options.rationale: Correct: confirming training/data-use controls is central to handling confidential data.

options.text: The colour theme of the interface
options.rationale: Theme has no bearing on data confidentiality.

options.text: The number of saved chats per user
options.rationale: Chat count is not a confidentiality control.

items.explanation: Correct: retention settings govern how long and whether data is kept.
